en.specs.title: The real numbers, straight from the listing
en.s1.b: Strong magnets hold the phone in place for wireless charging - as the listing states, with Qi support for other devices.
en.s2.b: A 20W wired output over USB-C Power Delivery - so the phone charges fast, and the bank itself takes 4 hours to fill up.
en.s3.b: A 10,000 mAh lithium polymer battery that covers several charges - suited to travel, work and daily use.
en.s4.b: It does magnetic and Qi wireless charging plus USB-C wired charging - so you can use whatever is at hand.
en.s5.b: 205 grams and 14 × 7 × 1.6 cm - it fits a pocket or bag without eating space, and the cell is lithium polymer.
en.s6.b: The listing states a 12-month Joyroom warranty, model JR-W020, and China as the country of origin.
en.conn.title: The difference you feel on day one
en.conn.sub: A MagSafe magnetic bank and a plain Qi charging pad - the comparison shows why magnets save the fiddling
en.conn.m1Ls: A bit pricier because 10,000 mAh and 20W live in one device
en.conn.m1Bt: Cheaper because it is only a charger with no battery inside
en.conn.m2Ls: Anyone on the move who needs to charge while out
en.conn.m2Bt: Anyone who stays put and charges at a desk or at home
en.conn.m3Ls: The phone sticks on and keeps charging while you move, and you still get a 20W wired output
en.conn.m3Bt: You place and line up the phone, and a nudge can break the charging connection
en.conn.noteLs: If you charge on the go, or like leaving the phone cable-free, the magnets stop it slipping and stopping - and the bank carries 10,000 mAh with you instead of hunting for a socket.
en.conn.noteBt: A plain pad is fuss-free, but it stays tethered to the wall and needs a flat, still surface.

en.faq.title: Questions buyers ask
en.faq.a1: The battery is 10,000 mAh, lithium polymer, per the listing specs.
en.faq.a2: A 20W wired output over USB-C Power Delivery, plus MagSafe-compatible Qi wireless charging - and the listing gives 4 hours to refill the bank itself.
en.faq.a3: The listing says it wirelessly supports iPhone 12, 13, 14 and 15, plus any Qi Android phone and earbuds.
en.faq.q4: Do I need a stand or a special cable?
en.faq.a4: You need USB-C for wired charging and for refilling it - while the wireless side needs no cable plugged into the phone.
